entries.title: Hebrews 8:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 By the eternal priesthood of Christ the Levitical priesthood of Aaron is abolished; 7 and the temporal covenant with the fathers, by the eternal covenant of the Gospel.

sum.Or, chief, principal point, in both which senses [kephalaion ] is used by profane writers.

We have. 7:26-28 who. 1:3,13; 10:12; 12:2; Eph 6:20; Col 3:1; Re 3:21 the Majesty. 1Ch 29:11; Job 37:22; Ps 21:5; 45:3,4; 104:1; 145:12; Isa 24:14 Mic 5:4

entries.title: Hebrews 8:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: minister. 9:8-12; 10:21; Ex 28:1,35; Lu 24:44; Ro 15:8 the sanctuary. or, holy things. the true. 9:11,23,24 which. 11:10; 2Co 5:1; Col 2:11

entries.title: Hebrews 8:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
he should. 7:11-15; Nu 16:40; 17:12,13; 18:5; 2Ch 26:18,19 there are priests. or, they are priests. gifts.[Doron ,] gifts, or offerings, comprehended propitiatory sacrifices as well as freewill-offerings.

See. 11:4

entries.title: Hebrews 8:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
unto.[Hupodeigmati kai skia ,] or, "with the representation and shadow," as Dr. Macknight renders.

the example. 9:9,23,24; 10:1; Col 2:17 See. Ex 25:40; 26:30; 27:8; Nu 8:4; 1Ch 28:12,19; Ac 7:44 pattern.[Tupos ,] type, plan, or form.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:6

entries.content:
obtained. 7-13; 2Co 3:6-11 the mediator. 7:22; 12:24; Ga 3:19,20 covenant. or, testament. 7:22; 9:15-20 was established.[Nomotheteo ,] "was ordained (or established) by law."

upon. 8:10-12; Ro 9:4; Ga 3:16-21; Tit 1:2; 2Pe 1:4
